video_title: Cooper Flagg Postgame Press Conference | 29 Points, 11 Assists vs. Heat

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg on the team's late-game offensive execution
quotes.excerpt: we did a better job at that late in the game just spreading the floor
quotes.quote: We did a better job at that late in the game just spreading the floor, getting into different actions and shifting the defense, allowing for better driving lanes and angles and opening up the court a little bit.

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg on the Heat's defensive strategy against him
quotes.excerpt: they were making the game up, being in the gaps heavy and trying to slow us down
quotes.quote: They were making the game up, being in the gaps heavy and trying to slow us down, make us just play through the pass and hit the easy ones. So to start out early, just making the right play and guys were knocking down shots.

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg praises Walt's impact on the team
quotes.excerpt: Walt was great, you know, obviously he hasn't been with us for very long
quotes.quote: Walt was great, you know, obviously he hasn't been with us for very long, but for him to step up tonight and 6-for-7 from the field. I thought just his intensity and the way, I mean plus-22, for him to go out there and just play really, really hard and unselfish basketball and just really give to the team in every single way. I thought it was a really big step for our team.

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg on the possibility of playing for Team USA
quotes.excerpt: obviously for me, I've played for the country before, you know, when I was younger
quotes.quote: I haven't really thought about that. Obviously for me, I've played for the country before, you know, when I was younger, playing for under-17 team, stuff like that. So for me, it's obviously a pleasure to be able to play for my country, any chance I get. I have no idea what it's going to look like, that's a long way down the road. So obviously, if I was ever asked to be able to play for my country, that's something that I would love to do, and that would be amazing.

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg on the team's defensive identity and intensity
quotes.excerpt: it just sets the tone early, being physical, guys like PJ and Zach
quotes.quote: It just sets the tone early, being physical, guys like PJ and Zach, those are things that they're going to bring to our team every single night. So for them to just continue to step up these last couple nights and really just showing how much they can provide us without even having to put the ball in the basket. I have no doubt that his shots are going to start to fall and there's nothing to worry about there. So with him contributing like he has been, it makes us so much better.

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg on PJ's defensive contributions
quotes.excerpt: PJ has been doing a lot for us on the defensive end
quotes.quote: PJ has been doing a lot for us on the defensive end, you know, he's been asked to take on some pretty tall tasks. So I think he's done an incredible job, you know, just doing whatever he can to help our team win. And I mean, PJ has been knocking his shots, doing what he does on the offensive end, but I mean, defensively, you know, he's been our anchor, you know, with him and Gaff and they've been holding down the fort.

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg on the value of veteran leadership
quotes.excerpt: those are two guys, Gaff, PJ, and then also have Kai, who's kind of like you guys are two pieces in a pod
quotes.quote: Those are two guys, Gaff, PJ, and then also have Kai, who's kind of like you guys are two pieces in a pod offensively. What's it like to have veterans on both sides of the balls that A, you can rely upon, but also know that they're setting the standard that not just you, but your teammates are looking at. It's been great, you know, those are two guys, Gaff, PJ, and then obviously Kai, just great vets who set the tone, set the example, and I think it's been great for me and for all the other young guys just to learn from.
